name: Havoc Dwarves
background:
Havoc Dwarves are those Dwarves who have embraced the Gods of Havoc. Their slow-moving soldiers are heavily armoured, supported by monstrous weapons and creatures created through dark rituals. 

The Havoc Dwarves’ ancestors were conquered by Orcs and abandoned by their former allies, and so they have embraced the Gods of Havoc. The Havoc Dwarves now seek to reclaim their ancient homes, building a new empire of blood and brutality so that they might never be humiliated and conquered again.
backgroundFull:
The Dwarven tribes were once spread throughout Tyria, but as the plains were settled by humanity and Orcs came to the steppe, the Dwarves retreated into the mountains, building the Dwarfholds. The Dwarves’ ability to channel magic was limited compared to other species, so instead Dwarves became crafters and inventors, using runes to enchant items and imbue them with magic which their Rune Masters could later use.

When Havoc arrived in Tyria, the northern Dwarfholds were overrun by followers of Havoc, while the southern Dwarves joined the campaign against Havoc. Seeing their opportunity, the Orcs attacked and soon conquered the southern Dwarfholds. The southern Dwarves had a difficult life under the Orcs. The Orcs drove the Dwarves out of their holds and took whatever they wished from their subjects. The Dwarves held little status, reduced to performing hard labour in the fields and mines, and with their former allies too weakened to help, they lived under cruel Orc rule for generations.‍

When the Great Rift opened, it tore through much of the Dwarven lands. Many Orcs were killed by cave-ins, whilst the rest were forced to abandon the holds, leaving behind much of their armour and weapons, and the Dwarves rose up and drove away any Orcs who remained. Some Dwarves began to follow the Havoc Gods, claiming that it was Havoc who liberated them while their former allies abandoned them. These Havoc-worshipping Dwarves consolidated in the northern Dwarfholds.

When the Havoc Gods saw the lack of arcane potential in their Dwarven followers, their attention shifted to other mortal followers. While their gifts still appeared amongst the Havoc Dwarves, it was far more difficult for the Dwarves to catch the attention of their new patrons. In order to account for their lack of Magic, they began to use captives as conduits for powerful rituals and magic. Through this experimentation, they have discovered how to use blood magic to overcome their natural weakness. Some Havoc Dwarves have managed to catch the attention of their gods once more using this magic. However, Havoc Gods’ interest is ever-fleeting. 

To further impress the Havoc Gods, the Dwarves have used their mechanical knowledge to build more powerful war-machines, golems, and weapons. They do this in the vain hope that the blood they shed and the empires that they build may finally satisfy their aloof patrons. 

How will you appease the uncaring Gods?

specialRules.name: Steadfast Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Havocbound Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Havocbound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Havocbound
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, its weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Swift Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Swift. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Havocbound
specialRules.description: If this model has Havocbound, it always gets AP(+1) from Havocbound (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Purge
specialRules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Warrior
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, its weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Piercing Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Piercing Warrior, it always gets AP(+1) from Piercing Warrior (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Swift
specialRules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -2" range to a min. of 6" when charging it.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: As long as a unit where most models have this rule hasn't activated yet this round, pick one effect when it is attacked: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
